note:
Trial 36 ended in death. The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the message that the player was shot by a Pillager.

What I saw: a single crossbow pillager stood on a raised ledge directly ahead. I advanced with the shield raised and jumped toward the ledge, but health fell quickly from full to about half a heart over four actions, which suggests the arrows were landing despite the shield being held. On the jump-and-attack action the view suddenly showed stone walls, meaning I dropped into a pit near the ledge and lost sight of the pillager. Two more hits finished me before I could climb out. No kills were visibly confirmed.

Input notes: all act calls returned screenshots normally. The shield button did not appear to prevent damage, though I cannot tell from screenshots alone whether that was due to timing, the pillager's angle, or the shield not actually being raised.
